title: The Interactive Red Furniture Mind Hack

vo.en: Think of a random number now.

visual.description: An extreme macro close-up of a man's eye iris with digital light reflections.

vo.en: Double it. Now add eight. Got it?

visual.description: 3D golden numbers spinning and floating in a dark, atmospheric space.

vo.en: Divide by two and subtract your original number. You’re left with four, right?

visual.description: A man's finger writing mathematical equations on a transparent glass surface.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. You think your mind is private?

visual.description: Rapid digital static and analog television glitch effects flickering over a dark screen.

vo.en: Clear your head while looking at the center of the screen. Now, think of any color and any piece of furniture.

visual.description: A hypnotic, trippy geometric tunnel moving infinitely towards the camera.

vo.en: You're picturing a red chair. I used linguistic priming to hijack your brain.

visual.description: A sleek, modern red armchair rotating slowly in a minimalist, brightly lit studio.

vo.en: It feels like magic, but it’s actually a calculated exploit of how your brain processes data.

visual.description: A digital 3D model of a human brain with blue electrical synapses firing rapidly.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if I caught you, which is exactly why...

visual.description: A man's thumb rapidly scrolling through a futuristic social media feed on a smartphone.
